description: This PHP class defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) named PartialClaimAttachment used within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It encapsulates data related to partial claim attachments, including properties such as request ID, attachment ID, size, description, filename, file type, who added it, and the date it was attached. The class utilizes multiple traits for common functionalities and provides getter and setter methods for its properties, as well as methods to retrieve related entities like ClaimRequest and Employee.

classes.name: PartialClaimAttachment
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) representing a partial claim attachment with related metadata and references to other entities such as ClaimRequest and Employee within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of PartialClaimAttachment with provided data, including references to related entities.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Returns the request ID associated with this attachment.

methods.name: setRequestId
methods.description: Sets the request ID associated with this attachment.

methods.name: getAttachId
methods.description: Returns the attachment ID.

methods.name: setAttachId
methods.description: Sets the attachment ID.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the attachment.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the attachment.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the attachment.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the attachment.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the file type.

methods.name: getAttachedDate
methods.description: Returns the attached date as a formatted string.

methods.name: setAttachedDate
methods.description: Formats and sets the attached date.

methods.name: getClaimRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the associated ClaimRequest entity based on request ID.

methods.name: getAddedBy
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user who added the attachment.

methods.name: setAddedBy
methods.description: Sets the ID of the user who added the attachment.

methods.name: getAddedByEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee entity of the user who added the attachment.

methods.name: setAddedByEmployee
methods.description: Attempts to set the addedByEmployee reference based on addedBy.
